steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Gate. A deal needs a margin above the floor, approved non-standard terms, and an approver with authority.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

findings.title: Margin below the floor
findings.fix: Re-price the deal or get a written exception

findings.title: Approval given without authority for the value
findings.fix: Send to an approver with authority

outcome.notChecked: Whether the buyer will sign; the legal effect of any term.

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 3 findings (2 high, 1 medium).
[high] deal-large-02.md:12  Margin below the floor.
       Fix: Re-price the deal or get a written exception.
[high] deal-terms.md:19  Non-standard term with no approval.
       Fix: Get the approval before closing.
[medium] deal-approvals.md:26  Approval given without authority for the value.
       Fix: Send to an approver with authority.
Not checked: Whether the buyer will sign; the legal effect of any term.
pros: Checks a margin below the floor, a non-standard term with no approval, and an approval given by someone without authority for the value.
cons: Not checked: Whether the buyer will sign; the legal effect of any term.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-sales-deal-review skill on the records for this review.
